content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 16.5 gives a mutual waiver of special/indirect/punitive/incidental/consequential damages with carve-outs for the Article 10 and Sections 16.1/16.2 indemnities and for gross negligence/willful misconduct, but the Agreement contains **no aggregate cap** anywhere — direct liability (including Ono's broad product-liability indemnity) is unlimited for both Parties. That fails the fallback on a material term, so I classified it a **deviation** and proposed the single shortest cure: a new Section 16.7 at the **fallback** level setting a mutual cap of 12 months' amounts payable by Ono, with indemnification, Article 10 confidentiality, and gross negligence/willful misconduct expressly outside the cap. The existing mutual consequential-damages waiver was left verbatim.
